answer: Pay only through willow roots: each verified job for a stranger plants a root bound to the agent key and its counterparties, deepening only with time and distinct partners, never transplantable to a clone. Payout climbs a mesa in steps, each step needing deeper roots, and the flat top caps what one root system draws per epoch. A hollow shell with no roots draws nothing. A sybil farmer must grow n root systems, paying n upkeep tolls and n work histories, yet n shallow roots yield less than one deep root, so cost rises with n while revenue per clone falls.
